statement: Valve Steam input udev rules line 5 apply uaccess with static node to generic /dev/uinput, not conditioned on the Steam 2026 VID/PID, and line 17 enables USB power/wakeup on matching vendor 28de devices with power/wakeup attr. Uinput access potentially permits host-wide input injection; the wakeup action is not a permission grant. Actual host permission provisioning or Steam client use: No evidence.

applicability.revision: Valve udev 22ec85e5 / Linux v7.3-rc1 / SDL3 6defbc0 inspected; actual device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Direct 28de:1302 open path, other 2026 IDs only for conditional permission applicability; no host or physical evidence
